title: Experiencers' account of breeding experiments and ecological messages

tellings.quote: following seems to be their story not my story but their story they're doing freting experiments for reasons we don't know

plain: People who say they have met non-human beings, often called experiencers, describe those beings as running breeding experiments on humans for unknown reasons and passing on messages about the Earth's ecology. An engineer named Bob McGwier relays this, stressing that it is their story, not his. If true, it would mean someone is reshaping humans and trying to warn us about the planet.
